calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Plant Addicts
calls.summary: Chris Link and Richard Anderson (co-founders of Plant Addicts) sought a user-friendly A/B testing tool to scientifically improve conversion rates and AOV, starting from zero. Scott Keller (GrowthBook enterprise sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) demoed the platform, highlighting its visual editor (Pro version, $40/month) as a simpler alternative to the code-heavy core product. Next steps: Plant Addicts will evaluate VWO before deciding, and Scott will share pricing and visual editor documentation.
